question: The revamp of Nikosia’s Makariou-Stasikratous-Evagorou commercial triangle, which took place under the 2014-2020 programming period cost a total of around EUR 24.7 million according to published figures. Of this, EUR 20.995 million (i.e. 85 %) came from European funding. The project was part of actions for sustainable mobility and the reduction of CO₂ emissions. In view of the above: 1.
What transparency and disclosure obligations applied to the contract, beneficiaries and use of European funds and which competent authority is required to ensure that these obligations are met?
Can the Commission publish or refer to the document that sets out the terms for supporting the project, as well as to subsequent amendments?

Has the Republic of Cyprus or the European Commission carried out a formal assessment as to whether the reopening of Makariou III Avenue to general traffic is compatible with the terms of the co-financing project?
